# Tree Grid

Navigate hierarchical rows and editable columns in one structured grid.

## Examples

### Expanded

Start with descendants visible and keep expansion independent from selection.

<ComponentExample component="tree-grid" scenario="expanded" title="Expanded" description="Start with descendants visible and keep expansion independent from selection." :index="0" />

### Unavailable cells

Skip cells that cannot be focused or edited while preserving row structure.

<ComponentExample component="tree-grid" scenario="unavailable-cells" title="Unavailable cells" description="Skip cells that cannot be focused or edited while preserving row structure." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow keys</kbd> | Move between grid cells. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the current cell or row. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>F2</kbd> | Enter edit mode when the current cell supports editing. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancel the active edit. |

## Accessibility

Rows and cells expose hierarchy, position, expansion, selection, and edit state inside a labeled grid.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/treegrid/) for the host accessibility contract.
